name: BRAND TEXT
description:
The Sauna King is a trusted Australian importer and distributor of infrared saunas. Their extensive showroom is in Clovelly Park, Adelaide, alongside their office and warehouse. The Sauna King offers free Metro delivery to four capital cities and detailed personalised quotes to all areas of Australia.



The range of infrared saunas stocked by The Sauna King is extensive. All designs imported for customers are sleek and modern and would be an asset to each home. All spaces and sizes are catered for too. The compact single person sauna cabin for one is made from Western Red Cedar and is an excellent budget option for those purely seeking to enjoy health benefits or weight loss with immediate regular use. .



The Sauna King’s infrared saunas are sold with warranties as standard, including up to 10 years on heaters. If you find that your infrared sauna from The Sauna King has developed a fault and is outside warranty, Infrared Sauna Parts can help. Please contact us for further information.
